name: dashboard-gobernanza
description: Dashboard de Gobernanza de Datos - Monorepo

scripts.start:all: start "backend" cmd /k npm run start:backend & start "frontend" cmd /k npm run start:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.docker:test-portless: docker compose exec app portless testapp node test-server.js
